articles.title: Stefano Boeri to Transform Tbilisi Locomotive Factory into Green Neighbourhood
articles.summary: Stefano Boeri Architetti won the LOCO Alliance competition in Tbilisi. The proposal will convert a former locomotive factory into a green neighborhood and cultural park. The project addresses a large brownfield site.

articles.title: Four Brazilian Houses Frame the Sea Views
articles.summary: Four Brazilian houses are designed to frame views of the sea. The project explores how architecture can capture coastal perspectives. It highlights thoughtful residential design.

articles.title: Foomann Architects Design Mornington House
articles.summary: Foomann Architects designed a holiday home for clients. It shares a block and pool with another house. The design focuses on the view and hosting guests.

articles.title: Tato Architects Designs House in Mibu
articles.summary: Tato Architects designed a house in Mibu. The project considers how architecture alters its surroundings. It asks whether interventions can heal rather than damage.

articles.title: Material Choices Shape Historic Building Additions
articles.summary: New additions to historic buildings raise questions about preserving character. Material selection helps contemporary interventions relate to old structures. The article examines this relationship.

articles.title: MOVS Studio Designs SIP Coffee and Bakery
articles.summary: MOVS STUDIO designed a coffee and bakery shop in a shopping mall. The studio aimed to give visitors a short rest from busy spaces. The design responds to commercial context.

articles.title: LJL Architects Designs Creasvalley Clubhouse
articles.summary: LJL Architects designed a clubhouse for Creasvalley. The site may be artificial but can become landscape over time. The clubhouse is conceived as part of its environment.

articles.title: Estudio Balzano Designs Montana Farm
articles.summary: Estudio Balzano designed a horse breeding and training facility. The project combines architecture, landscape, and equine needs. It focuses on high-level show jumping horses.

articles.title: h3o Architects Designs Relámpago House
articles.summary: The house materializes lightning as a central element. Lightning becomes wall and light, structuring interior spaces. The design uses weather as architectural inspiration.

articles.title: PROMONTORIO Designs Ombria Hotel in Algarve
articles.summary: The project is a hotel and apartments at Quinta da Ombria. It is set in a large estate with citrus groves and biodiversity. The design responds to dramatic landscape.

articles.title: Dunhua Tower Redefines Residential High-Rise Design
articles.summary: Dunhua Tower is a 17-story residential tower in Taipei. It uses an L-shaped footprint to create contrasting facades. The design combines materiality, geometry, and sustainable design.

articles.title: Statik PowerStand Turns USB-C Cable into Phone Stand
articles.summary: The Statik PowerStand uses a USB-C cable as a folding phone stand. It aims to make charging and viewing more useful. The product converts cable into stand.

articles.title: Slurptop DIY Laptop Pairs Power-Tool Styling With Swappable Battery
articles.summary: The Slurptop DIY Laptop borrows its battery from a toolbox and wraps mini PC hardware in chunky power-tool styling. Its homemade cyberdeck design embraces a swappable battery system.

articles.title: HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition Brings AI Conversations to Old-School Phone
articles.summary: The HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition adds AI conversations to a classic flip phone. It aims to make calling feel familiar rather than requiring new software skills.

articles.title: Glow-in-the-Dark Carabiner Is $6 Camping EDC Upgrade
articles.summary: This $6 glow-in-the-dark carabiner might be a big upgrade for camping EDC. The brand added glow to everyday carry items people fear losing in the dark.

articles.title: Five Pocket-Sized EDC Tools for Hating Bulky Multitools
articles.summary: A collection of five pocket-sized EDC tools for people who dislike bulky multitools. The lineup includes pliers, blades, drivers, and openers in compact forms.

articles.title: Spanish Home Uses Curved Roofs and Cork Walls for Natural Cooling
articles.summary: Casa Vereda in Spain uses curved roofs and cork walls to stay naturally cool. The design blends bold architecture with sustainable climate control.

articles.title: Titanium Watch Turns Yuri Gagarin’s First Orbit Into a Dial
articles.summary: A titanium watch design transforms Yuri Gagarin's first orbit into its dial. It references the Speedmaster legend while adding space history to the face.

articles.title: Jenga Tower Lamp Lights Up as You Stack It
articles.summary: A Jenga tower that doubles as a lamp, lighting up as blocks are stacked. The Toronto architecture studio PARTISANS created the playful design.

articles.title: Bellavista 11 Folds Concrete Planes Down Ibiza Hillside
articles.summary: Bellavista 11 folds thin white concrete planes down an Ibiza hillside toward the sea. Designed by Fran Silvestre Arquitectos, it makes hillside living feel fluid.

articles.title: Titanium Smart Glasses Concept Refuses to Hide Its Tech
articles.summary: A titanium smart glasses concept integrates computer components without hiding them. The design tackles the challenge of making electronics belong in glasses.

articles.title: Nine Red-to-Aluminum Ducati Customs Will Ever Exist
articles.summary: Only nine red-to-aluminum Ducati customs will ever be made. The custom paint job replaces traditional covering on the vehicle.

articles.title: Lavvu Tiny Home Has Bathtub and Hidden Storage
articles.summary: Lavvu's tiny home includes a full-size bathtub and hidden storage. The XL specification packs practical amenities into small living space.

articles.title: spacon Designs adidas Copenhagen Curtains and Sneaker Carpets
articles.summary: spacon created perforated aluminum curtains and vintage shoe box carpets for adidas Copenhagen. The fitting room curtains map running paths and carpets document sneaker culture.

articles.title: STEFANO BOERI TRANSFORMS LOCOMOTIVE FACTORY INTO GREEN NEIGHBORHOOD
articles.summary: The winning loco park masterplan reimagines a 73,600-square-meter industrial site in Tbilisi with nine residential buildings, public parks, and pedestrian routes. It transforms the abandoned site into a sustainable neighborhood.

articles.title: MASSIMODUTTI IN NEW YORK WITH PATTI SMITH PORTFOLIOS
articles.summary: Massimo Dutti explores New York's cultural memory with an exhibition on Bowery alongside its multi-disciplinary SoHo debut.

articles.title: STEPPED TIMBER PLATFORMS SHAPE CIRCULAR DÜSSLER HOME
articles.summary: Urselmann Interior renovates a 1939 apartment in Düsseldorf using reversible dry joinery and nine take-back agreements for a circular interior.

articles.title: THINKING WITH ANIMALS IN SICILIAN VILLAGE EXAMINES DIVIDE
articles.summary: Co-director Marco Navarra discusses an ecological regeneration project connecting community life and design in the post-anthropocene era.

articles.title: 6 Non-Apple Gadgets By iPhone Designer
articles.summary: The post showcases non-Apple gadgets crafted by the designer responsible for the iPhone. It emphasizes his broader portfolio beyond Apple. The list offers insight into modern industrial design trends.

articles.title: iPhone Duo Screen Cracking Surge
articles.summary: An analysis attributes recent screen failures to Apple's on-site supply chain oversight. The report focuses on industrial product quality control issues. This incident highlights challenges in maintaining hardware reliability for major tech products.

articles.title: Sudhakar Nadkarni: India's Design Educator
articles.summary: The article profiles Sudhakar Nadkarni, a prominent figure who taught India to approach problems through design thinking. His methods influence educational curricula across the country. The piece reflects on his lasting legacy in design education.

articles.title: Streaming Library Shelf, Spill-Proof Curry Pot
articles.summary: Design Week features brief conceptual projects including a streaming library shelf and a spill-proof curry pot. The column also covers unrelated topics like spam zombies. Overall, it presents diverse everyday solutions.

articles.title: Local Manufacturing Calls for Nigerian Design Jobs
articles.summary: The article calls for local manufacturing to create employment opportunities for Nigerian designers. It discusses efforts to boost domestic design sector growth. The outlook points toward stronger regional economies.

articles.title: Indian Design Education: Sudhakar Nadkarni’s Legacy
articles.summary: This piece examines the enduring impact of Indian design educator Sudhakar Nadkarni on contemporary design education. His teachings shape curricula and inspire new generations of designers. The coverage celebrates his contributions.

articles.title: Apple Music Logo Created Using Sound Waves
articles.summary: Apple has revealed a new logo for Apple Music generated through sound waves. The collaborative effort involved musician Fred Again and reflects creative branding techniques. This rebrand marks the service's first since its 2015 launch.

articles.title: 19 Winners in Dezeen Architecture Public Vote
articles.summary: Readers of Dezeen selected 19 winning projects in the architecture awards public vote. The winners span renowned studios and local transformations. The results celebrate a mix of large-scale and community-focused architecture.

articles.title: Fragmented House Overlooks Lake Zurich
articles.summary: Thinly described as a cluster of interconnected volumes, the house in dark limestone and cedar overlooks Lake Zurich. Designed for harmony with surrounding terrain, it exemplifies innovative architectural form. The 1,000 square metre home showcases complex zoning.

articles.title: All-in-One Avant Toilet Innovates Cistern
articles.summary: Roca launches the Avant toilet integrating the cistern inside the bowl itself. This all-in-one design removes external plumbing components for a sleek form. It represents a rethink of traditional bathroom fixtures.

articles.title: Arrow-Shaped Viewpoint for Fehmarnbelt Tunnel
articles.summary: Arup created a zigzagging arrow-shaped viewpoint atop the demountable Pilen structure in Denmark. The elevated platform gives viewers views during tunnel construction. The design balances accessibility with structural stability.
